# Trading God Arena v10 — Elon Musk Edition

شبیه‌ساز معاملاتی با ۸ خدای هوش مصنوعی، بتل‌آرنا، درخت مهارت و مشاور ایلان — دسکتاپ‌اپتیمایز.

## Kit

- HTML
- Vanilla JS

## اجرا

```bash
# مستقیم در مرورگر باز کنید، یا:
python -m http.server 8000
```

> تک‌فایل (~۱۹۵KB)؛ بدون سرور.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.5, user-scalable=yes" />
    <title>Trading God Arena v10 · Elon Musk Edition · Desktop Optimized</title>
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0015" />
    <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
    <meta name="description" content="Trading God Arena v10 - Ultimate Trading Simulator with 8 AI Gods, Battle Arena, Skill Tree, Elon Advisor, Desktop UI, Bot Timeline & R1/R2/R3 Risk Manager." />
    <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json" />
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icon-192.svg" />
    <link rel="icon" href="favicon.ico" sizes="any" />
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@400;700;900&family=Inter:wght@300;400;600;700;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
    <style>
        /* ================================================================
               GLOBAL RESET & VARIABLES — DIVINE CYBER THEME v10
               ================================================================ */
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }
        :root {
            --bg-primary: #0a0015;
            --bg-secondary: #12082a;
            --bg-card: #1a0d3a;
            --bg-hover: #2a1a5a;
            --text-primary: #e8d5ff;
            --text-secondary: #a88bdd;
            --text-dim: #6a4a9a;
            --accent: #7c3aed;
            --accent-dim: rgba(124,58,237,0.15);
            --gold: #ffd700;
            --gold-bg: rgba(255,215,0,0.08);
            --cyan: #00d4ff;
            --cyan-bg: rgba(0,212,255,0.08);
            --purple: #b388ff;
            --purple-bg: rgba(179,136,255,0.08);
            --pink: #ff6bff;
            --pink-bg: rgba(255,107,255,0.08);
            --green: #00ff88;
            --green-bg: rgba(0,255,136,0.12);
            --red: #ff1744;
            --red-bg: rgba(255,23,68,0.12);
            --orange: #ff8a4a;
            --orange-bg: rgba(255,138,74,0.08);
            --radius: 8px;
            --radius-sm: 4px;
            --radius-lg: 14px;
            --radius-xl: 20px;
            --font: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
            --mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
            --display: 'Orbitron', 'Inter', sans-serif;
            --border: #2a1a5a;
            --border-strong: #4a2a8a;
            --shadow: 0 4px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
            --shadow-glow: 0 0 80px rgba(124,58,237,0.03);
            --transition: 0.2s ease-out;
            --header-height: 56px;
            --nav-height: 60px;
        }
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            font-family: var(--font);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--text-secondary);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: var(--text-primary);
        }
        #app {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100vh;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* ================================================================
               DIVINE HEADER v10
               ================================================================ */
        .divine-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 6px 14px;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            height: var(--header-height);
        }
        .divine-header .title {
            font-family: var(--display);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd700, #ff6bff, #7c3aed);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .divine-header .title .sub {
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-weight: 400;
        }
        .divine-header .stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .divine-header .stats .stat {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 3px;
        }
        .divine-header .stats .stat .val {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .divine-header .stats .stat .val.gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .divine-header .stats .stat .val.cyan { color: var(--cyan); }
        .divine-header .stats .stat .val.pink { color: var(--pink); }
        .divine-header .elon-badge {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            background: var(--gold-bg);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.2);
            padding: 2px 10px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--gold);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .divine-header .elon-badge:hover {
            background: var(--gold-bg);
            border-color: var(--gold);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        /* ================================================================
               TRADE HEADER
               ================================================================ */
        .trade-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: stretch;
            padding: 0 6px;
            height: 48px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .sell-box, .buy-box {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 2px 0;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
        }
        .sell-box { background: var(--red-bg); border: 1px solid var(--red); }
        .buy-box { background: var(--green-bg); border: 1px solid var(--green); }
        .sell-box .label, .buy-box .label {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .sell-box .price, .buy-box .price {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-family: var(--mono);
        }
        .sell-box .price { color: var(--red); }
        .buy-box .price { color: var(--green); }
        .sell-box:hover, .buy-box:hover { transform: scale(1.02); }
        .volume-box {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 4px;
            min-width: 100px;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 0 8px;
        }
        .volume-box .vol-val {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: var(--mono);
        }
        .volume-box .vol-btn {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 700;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .volume-box .vol-btn:hover {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* ================================================================
               TOOLBAR
               ================================================================ */
        .chart-tools-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 2px 12px;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            height: 32px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .chart-tools-row .left-tools {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .chart-tools-row .left-tools .symbol {
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .chart-tools-row .left-tools .symbol .sub {
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 0.55rem;
        }
        .chart-tools-row .left-tools .tf {
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 0 6px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .chart-tools-row .left-tools .tf.active {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--gold-bg);
        }
        .chart-tools-row .left-tools .tf:hover { border-color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .chart-tools-row .right-tools {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .chart-tools-row .right-tools .tool-icon {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .chart-tools-row .right-tools .tool-icon:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ================================================================
               MAIN CONTENT v10 — Desktop Adaptive Grid
               ================================================================ */
        .main-content {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            padding: 0 0 var(--nav-height) 0;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }
        .tab-content {
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .tab-content.active { display: flex; }

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: ARENA v10 — DESKTOP TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT
               ================================================================ */
        #tab-arena {
            padding: 8px;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        @media (min-width: 1024px) {
            #tab-arena {
                display: grid !important;
                grid-template-columns: 1.8fr 1.2fr;
                grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
                gap: 12px;
            }
            #tab-arena .arena-grid { grid-area: 1 / 1 / 2 / 2; }
            #tab-arena .trade-panel { grid-area: 2 / 1 / 3 / 2; }
            #tab-arena .position-box { grid-area: 1 / 2 / 2 / 3; }
            #tab-arena .gods-panel { grid-area: 2 / 2 / 3 / 3; }
            #tab-arena .battle-arena { grid-area: 3 / 1 / 4 / 3; }
        }

        .arena-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .arena-grid .full { grid-column: 1/-1; }
        .info-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 10px 12px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .info-card .row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            padding: 2px 0;
        }
        .info-card .row .label { color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 500; }
        .info-card .row .value { font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .info-card .row .value.green { color: var(--green); }
        .info-card .row .value.red { color: var(--red); }
        .info-card .row .value.gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .info-card .row .value.cyan { color: var(--cyan); }
        .info-card .row .value.pink { color: var(--pink); }

        .trade-panel {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 10px 12px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .trade-panel label {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 700;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.3px;
        }
        .trade-panel input[type="number"] {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 4px 8px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            outline: none;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .trade-panel input[type="number"]:focus {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(124,58,237,0.05);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row button {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 6px 0;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: var(--font);
            min-width: 40px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-buy {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green), #00cc66);
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,255,136,0.15);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-buy:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(0,255,136,0.25);
            transform: scale(1.02);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-sell {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red), #b71c1c);
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,23,68,0.15);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-sell:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(255,23,68,0.25);
            transform: scale(1.02);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-close {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-skill {
            background: var(--purple-bg);
            color: var(--purple);
            border: 1px solid rgba(179,136,255,0.1);
            font-size: 0.5rem;
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-skill:hover {
            background: var(--purple-bg);
            border-color: var(--purple);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-arena {
            background: var(--pink-bg);
            color: var(--pink);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,107,255,0.1);
            font-size: 0.5rem;
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-arena:hover {
            background: var(--pink-bg);
            border-color: var(--pink);
        }
        .trade-panel .leverage-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }
        .trade-panel .leverage-row input[type="range"] {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 80px;
            accent-color: var(--gold);
            height: 3px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }
        .trade-panel .leverage-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            appearance: none;
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--gold);
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .trade-panel .leverage-row .lev-val {
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 40px;
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .trade-panel .pair-select {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .trade-panel .pair-select select {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            padding: 2px 4px;
            outline: none;
        }
        .trade-panel .pair-select select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

        /* ===== v10 NEW: R1, R2, R3 Risk Manager ===== */
        .risk-manager {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 6px 8px;
            margin-top: 4px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .risk-manager .rm-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
        }
        .risk-manager .rm-row label { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .risk-manager .rm-row input[type="number"] {
            width: 50px;
            padding: 1px 4px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .risk-manager .rm-row button {
            background: var(--gold-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold);
            padding: 1px 8px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .risk-manager .rm-row button:hover {
            background: var(--gold);
            color: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        /* ================================================================
               POSITION BOX
               ================================================================ */
        .position-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 8px 12px;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 2px 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
            margin: 4px 0;
        }
        .position-box .pos-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        .position-box .pos-label {
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.3px;
        }
        .position-box .pos-value {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }
        .position-box .pos-value.green { color: var(--green); }
        .position-box .pos-value.red { color: var(--red); }
        .position-box .pos-value.gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .position-box .pos-value.cyan { color: var(--cyan); }
        .position-box .pos-value.small { font-size: 0.5rem; }

        /* ================================================================
               AI GODS PANEL
               ================================================================ */
        .gods-panel {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 8px 10px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .gods-panel .gods-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 700;
            padding-bottom: 4px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .gods-panel .gods-header .god-count { color: var(--gold); }
        .gods-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 4px;
            padding-top: 4px;
        }
        .god-card {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 4px 6px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            text-align: center;
            transition: var(--transition);
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .god-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--text-secondary);
            transform: scale(1.03);
        }
        .god-card .god-icon { font-size: 1rem; }
        .god-card .god-name {
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .god-card .god-status {
            font-size: 0.3rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .god-card .god-status .dot {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 4px;
            height: 4px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin-right: 2px;
        }
        .god-card .god-status .dot.green { background: var(--green); }
        .god-card .god-status .dot.red { background: var(--red); }
        .god-card .god-status .dot.gold { background: var(--gold); }
        .god-card .god-status .dot.cyan { background: var(--cyan); }
        .god-card .god-pnl {
            font-size: 0.35rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .god-card .god-pnl.green { color: var(--green); }
        .god-card .god-pnl.red { color: var(--red); }
        .god-card .god-pnl.gold { color: var(--gold); }

        /* ================================================================
               BATTLE ARENA
               ================================================================ */
        .battle-arena {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 8px 10px;
            margin: 4px 0;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .battle-arena .battle-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding-bottom: 4px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .battle-arena .battle-header .battle-title {
            font-family: var(--display);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .battle-arena .battle-header .battle-mode {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .battle-arena .battle-header .battle-mode select {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            padding: 1px 4px;
            outline: none;
        }
        .battle-arena .battle-field {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            padding: 6px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .battle-arena .battle-field .fighter {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 4px 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            text-align: center;
            min-width: 60px;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .battle-arena .battle-field .fighter.active {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--gold-bg);
        }
        .battle-arena .battle-field .fighter .f-icon { font-size: 0.9rem; }
        .battle-arena .battle-field .fighter .f-name {

        .battle-arena .battle-actions button {

            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .battle-arena .battle-actions button:hover {

            color: var(--gold);

        }
        .battle-arena .battle-actions button.active {
            border-color: var(--pink);
            color: var(--pink);

        .battle-arena .battle-log {

        .battle-arena .battle-log .log-entry .highlight {

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: QUOTES
               ================================================================ */
        .quotes-list {
            display: flex;

        }
        .quote-item {
            display: flex;

            transition: var(--transition);

        .quote-item:hover { border-color: var(--text-dim); }
        .quote-item .q-pair { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; }
        .quote-item .q-price {

            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-family: var(--mono);
        }
        .quote-item .q-change {
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        .quote-item .q-change.up { background: var(--green-bg); color: var(--green); }
        .quote-item .q-change.down { background: var(--red-bg); color: var(--red); }

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: CHARTS v10 — Close Button & Elon Tweets
               ================================================================ */
        #tab-charts {
            padding: 0;
            height: 100%;
            position: relative;
        }
        .chart-container {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            position: relative;
            height: 100%;
        }
        #chartCanvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            min-height: 350px;
            display: block;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            touch-action: none;
            cursor: crosshair;
        }
        .chart-controls {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2px;
            padding: 2px 4px;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .chart-controls button {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 0 6px;
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .chart-controls button:hover {
            border-color: var(--text-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .chart-controls button.active {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--gold-bg);
        }

        /* ===== v10 NEW: Floating Close Button on Chart ===== */
        #chartCloseBtn {
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            right: 10px;
            background: var(--red-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--red);
            color: var(--red);
            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            z-index: 10;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }
        #chartCloseBtn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
            background: var(--red);
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: LEADERBOARD v10 — Bot Timeline & Event History
               ================================================================ */
        .leaderboard-container {
            padding: 8px;
        }
        .leaderboard-container .lb-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 8px 12px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .leaderboard-container .lb-card .lb-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 700;
            padding-bottom: 4px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .leaderboard-container .lb-card .lb-header .lb-title {
            font-family: var(--display);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .lb-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 3px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .lb-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
        .lb-item .lb-rank {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold);
            min-width: 20px;
        }
        .lb-item .lb-name { flex: 1; padding-left: 4px; }
        .lb-item .lb-pnl { font-weight: 600; }
        .lb-item .lb-pnl.green { color: var(--green); }
        .lb-item .lb-pnl.red { color: var(--red); }
        .lb-item .lb-pnl.gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .lb-item.lb-top1 { background: var(--gold-bg); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
        .lb-item.lb-top2 { background: var(--purple-bg); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
        .lb-item.lb-top3 { background: var(--cyan-bg); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }

        /* ===== v10 NEW: Bot & Trade Timeline ===== */
        .timeline-container {
            max-height: 400px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .timeline-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 4px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-time {
            color: var(--text-dim);
            min-width: 40px;
            font-size: 0.4rem;
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-icon { font-size: 0.6rem; }
        .timeline-item .tl-desc { flex: 1; }
        .timeline-item .tl-desc .highlight { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }
        .timeline-item .tl-pnl {
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 40px;
            text-align: right;
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-pnl.green { color: var(--green); }
        .timeline-item .tl-pnl.red { color: var(--red); }
        .timeline-item .tl-pnl.gold { color: var(--gold); }

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: ELON FEED
               ================================================================ */
        .elon-feed-container {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 8px 12px;
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding-bottom: 4px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile .avatar {
            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--gold);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile .ename {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile .ehandle {
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-status {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-status .dot {
            width: 5px;
            height: 5px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--green);
            animation: pulse-dot 1.2s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulse-dot {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.2; }
        }
        .elon-feed-item {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            padding: 6px 8px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-text {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-text .highlight { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag {
            padding: 1px 8px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.4rem;
        }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.long { background: var(--green-bg); color: var(--green); }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.short { background: var(--red-bg); color: var(--red); }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.analysis { background: var(--cyan-bg); color: var(--cyan); }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.meme { background: var(--gold-bg); color: var(--gold); }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.news { background: var(--purple-bg); color: var(--purple); }
        .elon-feed-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            padding-top: 4px;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .elon-feed-actions button {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .elon-feed-actions button:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: SKILLS
               ================================================================ */
        .skills-detail {
            padding: 8px;
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 8px 12px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-header .skill-icon { font-size: 1.2rem; }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-header .skill-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.7rem; }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-header .skill-level { font-size: 0.5rem; color: var(--gold); }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-desc {
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 2px 0;
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-progress {
            height: 4px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-progress .fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--pink));
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: SETTINGS
               ================================================================ */
        .settings-container {
            padding: 8px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 6px 8px;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .text-xs {
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex label {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex input[type="checkbox"] { accent-color: var(--gold); }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex button {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex button:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex button.active {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--gold-bg);
        }

        /* ================================================================
               BOTTOM NAVIGATION
               ================================================================ */
        .bottom-nav {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-around;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 4px 4px env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 4px) 4px;
            z-index: 100;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item .nav-icon { font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.2; }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item.active {
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--gold-bg);
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item .badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: -4px;
            right: -4px;
            background: var(--red);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 0.3rem;
            padding: 0 4px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ================================================================
               TOAST, DOPAMINE, CONFETTI
               ================================================================ */
        .toast {
            position: fixed;
            top: 80px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-20px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 8px 20px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            z-index: 9999;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            max-width: 92%;
            pointer-events: none;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .toast.show {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
        .toast.success { border-color: var(--green); }
        .toast.error { border-color: var(--red); }
        .toast.gold { border-color: var(--gold); }
        .toast.cyan { border-color: var(--cyan); }
        .toast.purple { border-color: var(--purple); }
        .toast.pink { border-color: var(--pink); }

        .confetti-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 99999;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .confetti-overlay .confetti-piece {
            position: absolute;
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            animation: confettiFall linear forwards;
        }
        @keyframes confettiFall {
            0% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(-10px) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(100vh) rotate(720deg) scale(0.2);
            }
        }

        .dopamine-banner {
            position: fixed;
            top: -100px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 10px 24px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 80px rgba(255,215,0,0.06);
            z-index: 99998;
            text-align: center;
            transition: top 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1);
            max-width: 92%;
        }
        .dopamine-banner.show {
            top: 20px;
        }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-icon { font-size: 1.8rem; display: block; }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 900; }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.green { color: var(--green); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.red { color: var(--red); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.pink { color: var(--pink); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-sub { font-size: 0.55rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-streak {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--gold-bg);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.1);
            padding: 1px 14px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        /* ================================================================
               RESPONSIVE v10 — Desktop Optimizations
               ================================================================ */
        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .divine-header .title { font-size: 1.2rem; }
            .divine-header .stats { font-size: 0.7rem; gap: 16px; }
            .trade-header { height: 56px; padding: 0 12px; }
            .sell-box .price, .buy-box .price { font-size: 1.1rem; }
            .chart-tools-row { height: 38px; padding: 2px 16px; }
            .main-content { padding: 0 0 var(--nav-height) 0; }
            #tab-arena { padding: 12px; gap: 12px; }
            .trade-panel .btn-row button { font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 8px 0; }
            .gods-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
            .position-box { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
            #chartCanvas { min-height: 450px; }
            .timeline-container { max-height: 600px; }
            .leaderboard-container .lb-card { padding: 12px 16px; }
            .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile .avatar { width: 40px; height: 40px; font-size: 1.5rem; }
            .elon-feed-item .feed-text { font-size: 0.85rem; }
        }
        @media (min-width: 1024px) {
            .divine-header { padding: 8px 24px; }
            .trade-header { height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; }
            .sell-box .price, .buy-box .price { font-size: 1.3rem; }
            .chart-tools-row { height: 40px; padding: 2px 20px; }
            #tab-arena { padding: 16px; gap: 16px; }
            .trade-panel .btn-row button { font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 10px 0; }
            .position-box .pos-value { font-size: 0.9rem; }
            #chartCanvas { min-height: 550px; }
            .bottom-nav { padding: 6px 12px; }
            .bottom-nav .nav-item { font-size: 0.6rem; }
            .bottom-nav .nav-item .nav-icon { font-size: 1.3rem; }
        }

        /* ================================================================
               UTILITY CLASSES
               ================================================================ */
        .flex { display: flex; }
        .flex-col { flex-direction: column; }
        .gap-4 { gap: 4px; }
        .gap-8 { gap: 8px; }
        .items-center { align-items: center; }
        .justify-between { justify-content: space-between; }
        .wrap { flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .w-full { width: 100%; }
        .text-center { text-align: center; }
        .text-gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .text-green { color: var(--green); }
        .text-red { color: var(--red); }
        .text-dim { color: var(--text-dim); }
        .text-sm { font-size: 0.65rem; }
        .text-xs { font-size: 0.5rem; }
        .mt-4 { margin-top: 4px; }
        .mb-4 { margin-bottom: 4px; }
        .p-4 { padding: 4px; }
        .hidden { display: none !important; }
        .border-bottom { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .rounded { border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
        .bg-card { background: var(--bg-card); }
        .p-2 { padding: 2px; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app">
        <!-- ================================================================
        DIVINE HEADER v10
        ================================================================ -->
        <div class="divine-header">
            <div class="title">
                ⚡ GOD ARENA
                <span class="sub">Elon Edition v10</span>
            </div>
            <div class="stats">
